text: stammering lips: Heb. stammerings of lip | will he speak: Or, he hath spoken
trodden down by it: Heb. a treading down to it
to understand the report: Or, when he shall make you to understand doctrine
the principal wheat: Or, the wheat in the principal place, and barley in the appointed place | rye: Or, spelt | place?: Heb. border
For his God doth instruct him to discretion: Or, and he bindeth it in such sort as God doth teach him
